tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250nor lha spyi'i gtor chog bzhugs so// 1$0000300hūm̐: byang phyogs gter gyi gzhal yas nas: nor gyi dbang phyug dzam+bha la: dzam lha rigs dgu nor dbang bcas// nor rgyun ma dang lha mo dpal// phag gdong mched lnga gang mdzes gnyis// kun 'khyil mched gsum ye shes grags// thugs rjes gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: ji srid bar du brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: stong gsum 'di 'am gzhan dag gi: dpal 'byor blo yis blangs te 'bul: yid sprul rtags brgyad rgyal srid bdun: dngos 'byor mchod gtor 'di 'bul bzhes: oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzam+bha la hri da ya hūm̐ phaṭa: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ya dha na me dhi sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ dzaluṃ swā hā: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā: i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma dzam+bha la sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: i daṃ= oṃ āḥbā su pā shaṃ hūm̐ dza: i daṃ= oṃ bā su dhā ri ṇ+ye swā hā/ i daṃ= oṃ de bī shrī yai swā hā/ i daṃ= oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra yak+ṣaṃ dhā ri ṇī hūm̐ dzaḥrat+na sid+dhi swā hā: i daṃ= oṃ ma hā kā la yak+sha de bī bha dhi hūm̐/ dhi dha he lu swā hā/ i daṃ= oṃ tshom me le u me ni du kha then swā hā/
i daṃ= tri'u tri'u/ i daṃ= ar+ghaṃ

shab+da pra tīts+tsha= hūm̐: bde gshegs sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin: gzugs kyi skur sprul dzam+bha la: dran pa tsam gyis dbul phongs sel: dzaṃ lha rigs dgu la sogs pa'i// nor lha'i tshogs la bdag bstod do// thog med ser sna'i las bsags rnams: mthol bshags byang zhing dag gyur cig: dbul phongs thams cad zhi ba dang: dpal 'byor nor dbyig 'phel zhing rgyas: 'dod dgu snang srid dbang du sdus: snyigs dus mu ge'i bskal pa zlogs: thugs dam dus babs sa ma ya: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod:
ces gnam chos dzam lha spyi'i las byang nang du nor lha yan gar rnams bcug ste rang gi thugs dam bya phyir rā ga a s+yas 'grub sbyor nyin par bsgrigs pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
